category.title: Abs
category.intro: Equipment-free programmes that strengthen the abdominal muscles and core. You start with basic moves that protect the spine, and the moves get harder as the weeks go on.
science: At the start, doing each move for short periods with correct form matters more than adding reps.
For holds like the plank, it's recommended to reach 20–30 seconds first and then make the move harder.
Moves like the bird-dog, side plank and short crunch work the core while keeping the lower back in its natural position.
Ab exercises alone don't burn belly fat; they improve muscular endurance and posture. Losing fat takes nutrition and overall movement.

exercises.name: Crunch
exercises.setup: Lie on your back, knees bent, soles of your feet on the floor. Arms by your sides, hands reaching towards your feet.
steps: Squeeze your belly and lift your head and shoulders off the floor; your hands reach towards your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top.
Slowly lower your shoulders to the floor.
exercises.tip: Breathe out as you rise. Your lower back stays on the floor; only your shoulders lift.
exercises.mistake: Don't pull on your neck to rise; keep a fist's width between your chin and chest.

exercises.name: Reverse Crunch
exercises.setup: Lie on your back, arms by your sides. Lift your knees into the air, bent at 90 degrees.
steps: Squeeze your belly and pull your knees towards your chest; your hips lift slightly off the floor.
Pause for a moment.
Lower your hips slowly and bring your knees back to the start.
exercises.tip: Do the move with your abs, not by swinging your legs.
exercises.mistake: Don't throw your legs around; keep the lowering slow and controlled.

exercises.name: Leg Raise
exercises.setup: Lie on your back, legs straight, arms by your sides, palms on the floor.
steps: Keeping your legs straight, lift them towards the ceiling.
Press your lower back into the floor and lower your legs slowly.
Lift them again before your heels touch the floor.
exercises.tip: If it's too hard, bend your knees slightly.
exercises.mistake: If your lower back lifts, don't lower your legs that far.

exercises.name: Heel Taps
exercises.setup: Lie on your back, knees bent. Lift your head and shoulders slightly, arms by your sides.
steps: Bend your body to the side and touch your right heel with your right hand.
Come back to the middle and touch your left heel with your left hand.
Keep alternating with your shoulders off the floor.
exercises.tip: The movement is small; reach by bending your body to the side.
exercises.mistake: Don't drop your head to the floor and lift it again; keep your shoulders up the whole time.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.target: Deep abdominal muscles and core stability
exercises.setup: Lie on your back. Reach your arms to the ceiling and lift your knees into the air, bent at 90 degrees.
steps: Slowly extend your right arm behind your head and your left leg forward.
Return to the start.
Do the same with your left arm and right leg.
exercises.tip: Breathe out as you extend; keep your lower back touching the floor the whole time.
exercises.mistake: If your lower back lifts, extend your leg less.

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunch
exercises.setup: Lie on your back, hands behind your head, shoulders slightly raised. Legs in the air.
steps: Pull your right knee to your chest while turning your left elbow towards it; extend your left leg.
Switch sides: left knee and right elbow.
Keep going in rhythm, like pedalling a bicycle.
exercises.tip: Touching elbow to knee isn't necessary; turning your body is enough.
exercises.mistake: Don't pull your head with your hands; let the turn come from your body.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.setup: Lie face down. Put your elbows under your shoulders and lift your body onto your toes.
steps: Form a straight line from your head to your heels.
Draw your belly in and squeeze your glutes.
Breathe easily and hold until the time is up.
exercises.tip: If your form breaks, put your knees down and carry on.
exercises.mistake: Don't let your hips drop or rise.

exercises.name: Kneeling Plank
exercises.setup: Lie face down. Elbows under your shoulders, knees on the floor, feet in the air.
steps: Lift your body; form a straight line from your head to your knees.
Draw your belly in gently.
Keep breathing and hold.
exercises.tip: The starting version of the plank; move to the normal plank once 30 seconds feel easy.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.setup: Lie on your side, elbow under your shoulder, legs straight and stacked.
steps: Lift your hips; form a straight line from your head to your feet.
Reach your top arm towards the ceiling.
Switch sides halfway through.
exercises.tip: If it's hard, put your bottom knee down.
exercises.mistake: Don't let your hips sag to the floor.

exercises.name: Kneeling Side Plank
exercises.setup: Lie on your side, elbow under your shoulder, knees bent and stacked.
steps: Lift your hips; form a straight line from your head to your knees.
Reach your top arm towards the ceiling.
Switch sides halfway through.
exercises.tip: The easy version of the side plank; once it's comfortable, do it with straight legs.
exercises.mistake: Don't let your shoulder sink towards your ear.

exercises.name: Mountain Climber
exercises.setup: Get into a push-up position: hands under your shoulders, arms straight, body in a straight line.
steps: Pull your right knee towards your chest.
As you take it back, pull your left knee in.
Keep going in rhythm with your hips steady.
exercises.tip: Get the form right before you speed up; slow is fine.
exercises.mistake: Don't lift your hips up or let your back sag.

exercises.name: Plank Shoulder Taps
exercises.setup: Get into a push-up position; spread your feet a little to make balancing easier.
steps: Touch your left shoulder with your right hand.
Put your hand down and touch your right shoulder with your left hand.
Keep alternating without rocking your hips.
exercises.tip: If it's too hard, put your knees down.
exercises.mistake: Don't rock your hips sideways with each tap.

exercises.name: Hollow Hold
exercises.setup: Lie on your back and stretch your arms overhead.
steps: Press your lower back into the floor and lift your shoulders and legs off the floor.
Your body should curve slightly like a bowl.
Keep breathing and hold.
exercises.tip: If it's too hard, bend your knees or bring your arms to your sides.
exercises.mistake: If your lower back lifts, raise your legs higher.

exercises.name: Flutter Kicks
exercises.setup: Lie on your back, hands under your hips, legs straight and lifted slightly off the floor.
steps: Move one leg a little up and the other a little down.
Alternate like scissors.
Keep your lower back on the floor and keep going in rhythm.
exercises.tip: Keep the movement small and continuous.
exercises.mistake: If your lower back lifts, keep your legs a little higher.

exercises.name: Bird-Dog
exercises.setup: Get on all fours: hands under your shoulders, knees under your hips.
steps: Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back.
Pause briefly when your arm and leg are parallel to the floor.
Bring them back slowly; switch sides halfway through.
exercises.tip: Imagine a glass of water on your back; don't spill it.
exercises.mistake: Don't let your lower back sag or your hips turn to the side.
